fail.text: Failed — **pulled 10 feet** toward the centre of the Singularity.

success.text: Saved — half damage and not pulled.

automation.text:
Run this for each creature that **starts its turn** inside the Singularity.
**Entropic Collapse** — a creature reduced to 0 HP by this is consumed by swirling darkness. At your option it is either instantly **killed** (its body dissolves into black ash) or **transported** to a harmless demiplane of emptiness, stabilizing at 0 HP and returning when the Singularity ends.
